# sonarqube_project_branches (Data Source)

Lists the branches of a project, main branch first, then by name. Branches other than the main branch exist once analyzed, and need the Developer edition or above.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sonarqube_project_branches" "api" {
  project = "example-api"
}

# Every analyzed release branch, e.g. for an application branch.
output "release_branches" {
  value = [for b in data.sonarqube_project_branches.api.branches : b.name if startswith(b.name, "release/")]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project` (String) Project key.

### Read-Only

- `branches` (Attributes List) Branches of the project. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--branches))
- `id` (String) The project key.
- `main_branch` (String) Name of the main branch.

<a id="nestedatt--branches"></a>
### Nested Schema for `branches`

Read-Only:

- `analysis_date` (String) Date of the last analysis; null if never analyzed.
- `excluded_from_purge` (Boolean) Whether the branch is kept when inactive.
- `is_main` (Boolean) Whether this is the main branch.
- `name` (String) Branch name.
- `quality_gate_status` (String) `OK` or `ERROR`; null if never analyzed.
- `type` (String) `BRANCH`.
